question: Should doctor cleanup for removed `google-antigravity-auth` stay limited to current shared stale-plugin surfaces, or may it also delete persisted `plugins.installs` and matching `plugins.load.paths`?
rationale: Current main already repairs stale entries, allow/deny lists, slots, and channel references through the shared helper, while this PR proposes broader persisted-state deletion that can affect upgraded user configs.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase
options.body: Move the accepted cleanup into the shared stale-plugin helper and leave install/load-path pruning out unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

options.title: Accept Broader Pruning
options.body: Keep install/load-path deletion only after live upgraded-host proof shows it removes stale state without deleting operator-owned plugin paths.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged if current main's generic stale-plugin repair is enough for the original warning path.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase
recommendation.body: Move the accepted cleanup into the shared stale-plugin helper and leave install/load-path pruning out unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: She introduced the shared stale-plugin doctor repair path that now owns this cleanup area.
